description: Declares what the Agentic OS control plane consists of, so os-control-plane-mode can enable and disable it as one unit. Members are switched through the ownership file and the plugin syncer; git guards are wired and unwired in .git/hooks; the declared mode lives in mode_file. Nothing outside this file decides what 'the control plane' is, and tests/test_control_plane_mode_manifest.py fails if a component mentions the control plane without being classified here.

git_guards.name: pre-commit-pipeline-guard
git_guards.purpose: blocks commits from a task branch that has not reached an implementation stage

git_guards.name: pre-push-review-guard
git_guards.purpose: blocks pushes from a task branch that has not cleared review and reached DONE

never_removed: context/control_plane.db and its task history (disable never deletes it)
skills/os-init and skills/os-health-check (they create and verify the substrate, including the disabled state)
the Claude Code plugin hooks in hooks/hooks.json (memory, evolution guard, metrics): not part of the control plane
pre-commit-evolution-guard: map-debt / evolution-log discipline is a separate feature with its own gate

excluded.reason: Creates the substrate (control_plane.db, hooks) and honours the declared mode; must stay installed in both modes.
Verifies the substrate and understands the disabled mode; must stay installed in both modes.
The evolution loop is independent of work-intake gating; it only mentions the control plane for optional prior-art logging.
General-purpose worktree selection and cleanup guidance; it mentions the control plane in one line only (retain the task's gates) and is useful with or without gating.
General coding rule; it mentions control_plane/constants.py only as a worked example.
General worktree hygiene. Its control-plane steps assume the control plane is enabled; making them conditional is a follow-up and is tracked in the changelog.
Stays installed: architecture design is useful with or without gating. Its registration step applies only when the control plane is enabled; making that conditional is a follow-up.
